title: REVELATION OF CELESTIAL MARRIAGE--SECRECY THE PRICE OF SAFETY--JOSEPH
author: Orson F. Whitney
note: Published 1888. Whitney (grandson, later apostle). 68 chapters. Incorporates extensive verbatim journal extracts.

footnotes.text: Heber was told by Joseph that if he did not do this he would lose his Apostleship and be damned.
The Prophet Joseph, I am informed, in blessing Heber C. Kimball, told him that his inheritance in Zion should adjoin his on the north.
